div.head: II Cn 54
div.ab: Gif wiffæst wer hine forlicge be his agenre wylne, þolige þære ⁊ bete for hine sylfne wið God ⁊ wið men.
Gif wiffæst wer hine forlicge be his agenre wylne, þolige þære ⁊ bete for hine sylfne wið Godd ⁊ wið men.
Si quis alligatus uxori (uxoratus) fornicetur cum ancilla sua, perdat eam et pro se ipso peniteat erga Deum et homines.
Gyf wiffæst wer hine forlicge be his agenre wylne, ðolie ðære ⁊ bete for hine sylfne wiþ Godd [⁊] wið men.
Gif wiffæst wer hine forligce be his agenre wylne, þolige þære and bete for hine sylfne wið God and wið men.
If a married man commits adultery with his own slave, he shall lose her and make amends for himself both to God and to men.
If a married man engages in intercourse with his own slave, she shall be confiscated and he must do penance for himself before God and the community.
If a married man commits fornication with his own slave-woman, he is to forfeit her and make amends for himself with God and with men.
Wenn ein verheiratheter Mann mit seiner eigenen Sklavin hurt, so verliere er diese und büsse für sich vor Gott und vor Menschen.
If a married man whores with his own slave-woman, let him lose her and atone for himself before God and before men.
